positions.title: New Product Introduction Project Manager
positions.description:
Assign and Manage ISC Project Leadership , Lead NPI, support Regional Configuration, In-Sourcing  
Technical focal point lead for AME NPI Team and regional ISC leaders
Provide project oversight on key AME deliverables and schedule
Provide resource planning for Manufacturing and Test Engineering

Lead NPI and Project Management process Development

positions.title: Program Project Manager
positions.description: Oversaw up to eight projects simultaneously.  Developed and managed the annual average budget of five million per project for the life of the program.  Communicated with other team leads, program management and customer to mitigate risks and keep projects on task.  Lead efforts to meet software level requirements, development, testing and initial production.  Developed and executed plans to meet program and customer milestones.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Creation of test procedures.  Verification of requirements implementation through detailed data analysis.  Document errors and verify they are corrected by the software team.  Support design and code reviews from the software team.  Write and create specification changes for multiple components. Wrote specifications and completed functional testing in an agile process for simulator training, for several sprints.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in multidisciplinary research and collaborated with equipment designers and hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems software. Provided software engineering support by creating and assisting with coding, testing, and documentation.
